request.source: Owner REV rollout thread, 2026-10-25/26: requested cited diagnostic findings and instructed implementation.
request.text: Enable advisory denial diagnostics in the SDK REV integration. Reports should identify the requirement, relevant evidence location, gap and next check, or state evaluator uncertainty when no concrete issue can be grounded. Verify citations, keep diagnostics separate from approval, preserve existing checks and thresholds, and do not change application behavior or publish a release.
